title: DOJ charges 28 with voting crimes. And, TikTok ignored staff's child safety concerns
description: The Justice Department has charged 28 people in California with voting crimes as Election Day nears. And, TikTok staff raised child safety concerns with executives, who failed to act, court records show.

title: DOJ charges 28 in California with voting crimes as election tensions escalate
description: The DOJ also filed an emergency request in federal court to stop California from processing ballots returned by people on the voter rolls the federal government says are "likely noncitizens."

title: Judge chastises Trump administration plan to push ahead overhaul of DC golf course
description: The Trump administration wants to turn a historic public golf course into championship links. Despite a judge's order, hundreds of trees were cut down to make way for the renovation.

title: Between the coasts, populist Democrats see room to reclaim lost ground in red states
description: In parts of the Great Plains and Midwest, Democrats are betting that harnessing anger at corporate power and both parties might succeed when voters believe the economy and government are not working.

title: 2026 midterms could be the most expensive on record. And, Macron condemns protests
description: More than $15 billion has been raised in this year's midterm elections. And, France's president is condemning the violent protests erupting across the country.

title: Rep. Don Beyer, D-Va., on Trump waiving sanctions on Russia
description: NPR's Leila Fadel asks Democratic Rep. Don Beyer of Virginia  about President Trump's decision to waive new sanctions on Russia.

title: The real reason it's going to take a while to know who won in some midterm races
description: Hint: It's not only because California counts slowly.

title: Michigan's Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed campaigns in GOP stronghold
description: Michigan's Democratic U.S. Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed is campaigning in the GOP stronghold of Michigan's Upper Peninsula, an area that hasn't voted for a Democrat in Congress in over a decade.

title: Democrats — and Elon Musk — continue to dominate midterm campaign fundraising
description: Democratic candidates are on offense with fundraising, and Republican super PACs continue to play defense heading into the final weeks of the midterm.

title: What does a White House press secretary do?
description: Katie Zacharia's short time as White House press secretary has brought renewed attention to the high-profile role.
